items.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
items.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

items.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s quantum threat is becoming an economic problem
items.summary: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

items.title: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
items.summary: Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

items.title: Crypto PACs made big Republican push in final weeks before November 3 election
items.summary: Even as polling and online wagers put Democrats at a high chance to claim greater power in Congress, the industry's high-profile support has gone the other direction.

items.title: Sherrod Brown's Ohio edge threatens a rough go for crypto next year
items.summary: The industry's $63 million question revolves around whether its political adversary in Ohio rides the Trump backlash back into the Senate.

items.title: Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack
items.summary: Binance reopens customer withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion exploit. Bitcoin leads the first phase.

items.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
items.summary: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.

items.title: DeepSeek developing AI agent requiring less human input: Report
items.summary: The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said.

items.title: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack
items.summary: The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea.

items.title: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.

items.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
items.summary: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

items.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
items.summary: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

items.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
items.summary: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

items.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
items.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

items.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
items.summary: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.

items.title: Uber tests how tokenization can put idle cash to work with HSBC, Franklin Templeton
items.summary: The pilot let Uber keep funds invested in money market products while accessing cash for payments, even on weekends.

items.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
items.summary: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.

items.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
items.summary: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

items.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
items.summary: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

items.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion
items.summary: The Binance hack has revived debates about whether decentralization is the digital asset industry’s greatest security advantage or its biggest point of weakness.
